# Art deco

Architectural rhythm and gold detail with quiet elegance.

## Use

Use for premium event pages, leadership communication, and milestone presentations.

## Essential traits

- Stepped ornamental border
- Gold-on-navy contrast
- Symmetrical composition

## Typography

Georgia serif headings with widely spaced short labels.

## Layout and surfaces

Symmetrical alignment, vertical rhythm, and restrained ornamental framing. Deep navy, thin gold rules, and stepped geometric corners.

## Palette

- background: #111d2d
- surface: #192a3b
- text: #fbf2db
- muted: #d4c6a3
- accent: #e3c789
- border: #8e7d56

## Copy-ready prompt

```text
Apply Art deco to [DELIVERABLE] for [AUDIENCE]. Purpose: [GOAL]. Preserve all supplied content, existing visuals, and required brand constraints. Georgia serif headings with widely spaced short labels. Symmetrical alignment, vertical rhythm, and restrained ornamental framing. Deep navy, thin gold rules, and stepped geometric corners. Palette: background #111d2d, surface #192a3b, text #fbf2db, muted #d4c6a3, accent #e3c789, border #8e7d56. Essential traits: Stepped ornamental border; Gold-on-navy contrast; Symmetrical composition. Avoid: Thin gold body text; Ornament behind reading text; Decorative fonts at small sizes. Keep motion restrained and optional, respect reduced motion, and provide a static fallback. Adapt the appearance to the requested output format. Keep text legible, controls accessible, and content editable where supported. Resolve mandatory brand conflicts explicitly. Return the design and accurately report performed and unperformed checks.
```

## Validation

Available style specification. Check the actual output; no blanket accessibility or visual-fidelity certification is claimed.
